description: Photoroom is an AI-powered photo editing tool specializing in background removal, object isolation, and product photography enhancement. Used by e-commerce sellers and marketers, it provides instant cutouts, batch processing, and creative effects to turn ordinary photos into professional assets. AI-powered photo editing tool and listing studio for quick, professional-quality visuals tailored to e‑commerce businesses and social media creators. It helps automate image creation, format for multiple marketplaces, and produce marketplace-ready listings at scale. Background Removal: Instantly isolate subjects from backgrounds. Batch Editing: Process multiple images at once. Templates: Ready-to-use layouts for social media and e-commerce. AI Effects: Add shadows, blur, and color enhancements.
